title: The person is a user illusion created by robots made of robots

statements.text: Humans are robots made of robots who together create a user illusion of a conscious person, a single unified agent, a self as a center of narrative gravity. The illusion is needed to describe others, each other and oneself.

sources.quote: create a user illusion of a Conscious Person, a single, unified agent, a self as a centre of narrative gravity
